svg.text: STAGE 435 · TOPIC 75 🎉 · P863 / P864 · SVG 79 · 438 DIMS
Enterprise SIP RFC 3263 / RFC 7984 DNS NAPTR/SRV Anti-Downgrade & Timer-B Blackhole Failover Guard
企业 SIP RFC 3263/7984 DNS NAPTR/SRV SIPS+D2T 防降级投毒、[1,4] 候选深度锁与 [500,2000]ms 死节点秒级熔断门禁（🎉 第 75 大专题历史性里程碑）
1. DNS NAPTR/SRV Anti-Downgrade & Allowlist Gate (P863)
• 痛点：DNS 投毒将 NAPTR SIPS+D2T 篡改为明文 SIP+D2U，导致全量语音信令裸奔
• 放大风险：恶意 SRV 记录指向非授信中继或构造超长候选链阻塞解析器线程池
❌ Attack: NAPTR service="SIP+D2U" downgrade | 16-hop untrusted SRV chain
✅ P863 Gate: Pin SIPS+D2T + Vetted Host Allowlist + [1, 4] SRV Depth Cap
Action: reject_sips_naptr_downgrade_and_enforce_dnssec_srv_allowlist
确定性收敛指标（P863）：
✔ clampedPlaintextDowngradeOrUntrustedSrvTargets = 0（0 明文降级与非法目标）
✔ clampedSrvCandidateMaxLookupDepth ∈ [1, 4]（防解析放大候选深度上限）
2. Dead-SBC Blackhole Fast Failover & Quarantine (P864)
• 痛点：主 SBC 机房静默丢包时，默认 Timer B = 32,000ms 导致每通电话卡死 32 秒掉线
• 秒级熔断：将单跳超时钳制在 [500, 2000]ms 并自动隔离死节点，后续呼叫 0ms 切备机
❌ Outage: Primary SBC silent drop -> Timer B=32000ms stalls 12 calls
✅ P864 Gate: [500, 2000]ms Per-Hop Failover + Local Quarantine Circuit-Breaker
Action: quarantine_dead_srv_trunk_and_failover_within_per_hop_budget
确定性收敛指标（P864）：
✔ clampedTimerBBlackholeStalledCalls = 0（0 通电话卡死在 32s 黑洞）
✔ clampedPerHopFailoverTimeoutMs ∈ [500, 2000] ms（毫秒级单跳故障转移预算）
3. Quantitative Evaluation Matrix & Production Verification Checklist (Stage 435 · Topic 75 🎉 · 438 Dims · 873 Guards · 877 Tests)
• Guardrail P863: evaluateSipRfc3263DnsNaptrSrvSipsTransportDowngradeAndTargetHostAllowlistGate => 0 downgrades | [1, 4] SRV depth
• Guardrail P864: evaluateSipRfc3263Rfc7984DeadSbcTimerBBlackholeCircuitBreakerAndFastFailoverGate => 0 stalls | [500, 2000]ms
• Checklist: [x] NAPTR SIPS+D2T Pinning [x] Vetted SRV Host Allowlist [x] [500,2000]ms Per-Hop Timer [x] Quarantine Circuit-Breaker
